lines.1: 「Everyone, you have your English exam today. Do your best.」
lines.2: 「I promise a very dull summer vacation to anyone who receives a failing mark.」
lines.4: Well, I intend to score perfectly.
lines.6: Naturally, the room is dead silent during the exam.
lines.7: I move my pen in total concentration.
lines.8: 「...A perfect score... I need a perfect score.」
lines.9: Having abandoned everything else to focus on English, I move smoothly through the questions.
lines.10: If I want time to check my answers, I can't afford to zone out.
lines.11: 「...? This question... Is it an advanced problem?」
lines.12: It is a difficult sentence to translate into English.
lines.13: The Princess would solve something like this easily.
lines.14: I cannot let her pull ahead here.
lines.15: I force my way through the problem on sheer determination.
lines.19: 「Crab, you say that every time. It is like saying this year's cold is especially nasty.」
lines.23: 「I do not think you should build your entire character around that verbal tic.」
lines.25: ...I have a good feeling about it.
lines.28: Now for the Japanese-to-English and English-to-Japanese translations...
lines.29: If those are right too, I have a perfect score.
lines.36: 「If you beat Ms. Kiriya, I will go on a date with you.」
lines.38: 「And if you lose, you will never speak to me in private again. That was our agreement, yes?」
lines.41: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga, that is what he said, correct?」
lines.45: 「Now we can finally deliver the finishing blow, boy.」
lines.48: 「I look forward to seeing the results on Monday.」
lines.50: I am confident. I won't lose.
lines.53: 「How did you find the English exam?」
lines.54: 「Well, unless the Earth ends, I scored a hundred.」
lines.57: Now all I can do is wait for Monday.
lines.60: 「What showdown? You've been picking fights with me a lot lately. Is that how you show affection?」
lines.61: 「Everyone, I am returning your exams now.」
lines.66: 「Why are you only reading my score out loud?!」
lines.67: 「Mr. Date, I will overlook a score like this, so please keep working hard at your club.」
lines.75: 「I wish you would always work this hard.」
lines.79: ...Damn. I lost two points on two Japanese-translation answers marked partial credit.
lines.81: She only praised me because everyone was watching.
lines.82: No matter how hard you work, getting a perfect score out of nowhere is still difficult...
lines.83: Reality had put me in my place.
lines.84: 「Leo, she praised you. What did you score?」
lines.85: 「Whoa! What is this?! Since when are you a genius?」
lines.87: 「...But I still don't know what the Princess scored!」
lines.88: 「Hey, Princess. What did you get in English?」
lines.89: 「A hundred, obviously. With my intellect, what else would I get?」
